feed.title: Judge OKs Ohio company's lawsuit vs. Trader Joe's over Uncrustables
feed.summary: A federal judge has allowed J.M. Smucker Co.'s lawsuit against Trader Joe's to proceed, rejecting Trader Joe's petition for early dismissal. Smucker alleges that Trader Joe's "Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches" too closely resemble its Uncrustables, copying their round shape, sealed edges, and packaging. Trader Joe's contends its sandwiches are "squircles" and the sealed edge is functional, but the ruling means the case will now move to the evidence-gathering stage.
